decision_boundary.purpose: Separate official non-GeoNames administrative evidence from GeoNames code-key/hierarchy evidence, for owner review.

geoNames_record_identity.source_note: Current GeoNames page identifies ID 192705 as ADM3 Kiambururu Sub-Location. Its hierarchy panel lists Kenya and the target only, with no parent link.

candidate_county_ancestor.name: Kiambu County

evidence_sources.authority: Kenya Law / Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission Act schedule
evidence_sources.title: Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission Act No. 9 of 2011, ward descriptions
evidence_sources.specific_finding: The Githunguri constituency schedule lists Ngewa Ward and describes it as comprising Giathieko, Kimathi, Nyaga and Kiambururu sub-locations of Kiambu County.
evidence_sources.evidence_scope: Strong official county-level ancestry evidence for the exact sub-location name; the table is a 2011 election-boundary schedule and does not contain the GeoNames ID.

evidence_sources.authority: Kenya Ministry of Interior / Kenya Gazette
evidence_sources.title: Gazette Vol. 17, 14 February 2024 — Special Issue, Administrative Units
evidence_sources.specific_finding: Under Kiambu County, Githunguri Sub-County, the gazette lists Kiambururu as a Location.
evidence_sources.evidence_scope: Current official hierarchy lead; the unit level differs from GeoNames' 'Kiambururu Sub-Location' wording, so exact entity-level identity and immediate parent path require review.

unresolved_points: The older IEBC schedule explicitly calls it a sub-location in Kiambu County, while the 2024 administrative-units gazette lists Kiambururu as a Location under Githunguri Sub-County.
Neither official table includes GeoNames ID 192705 or a direct identifier crosswalk.
The current GeoNames page has no parent link. The missing raw admin1 crosswalk key KE.01 remains absent.

evidence_sources.title: Sub Counties
evidence_sources.specific_finding: The county government's page identifies Central Imenti as one of Meru's administrative sub-counties and a parliamentary constituency.

evidence_sources.title: Sub County Administrators
evidence_sources.specific_finding: The county government list includes an administrator for IMENTI CENTRAL.

evidence_sources.authority: Kenya Gazette / Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission
evidence_sources.title: Kenya Gazette, 24 August 2022 — election result tables
evidence_sources.specific_finding: The official gazette places Central Imenti constituency under Meru County.

unresolved_points: The spelling/order varies between GeoNames 'Imenti Central' and county-government 'Central Imenti' in the administrative sub-counties list.
The government sources do not include GeoNames ID 7800132 or a direct identifier crosswalk.
The current GeoNames page has no parent link. The missing raw admin1 crosswalk key KE.03 remains absent.

important_note: The two current county-level records (Kiambu County GeoNames ID 8693007 and Meru County ID 8693009) are ADM2 entities distinct from the legacy/currently named ADM1 records Kiambu ID 192709 and Meru ID 186824. Do not use those ADM1 IDs interchangeably with the county-level ADM2 records.
